snippet.title: Zukarii - Taking Back Map Space From South & East Walls #actionrpg #gamedevblog #indiedev
snippet.description: It's been quite a journey converting my game Zukarii from a top down 2d sprite game to a Diablo II style prerendered 2.5D Isometric projection game. Today i built the first version of a system that fades walls when you walk behind them. This makes a huge difference in reclaiming the space tucked away behind the walls.
